labels.overridePaymentOption: Override Payment Option - Override all available payment options so that only American Express Credit/Debit card is a valid form of payment for all contacts, regardless of the individual eAdmin payment options.

labels.quickShop: Quick Shop - This is a search feature,that allows the user to enter part number, and quantity, and adds directly to a cart.

labels.disableUserChangeAbility: Disable Username Change Ability - Remove username edit access for all contacts for the session web group, regardless of the contact permission (Enable Change Login/Password).

labels.accessToInvoicehistory: - Grants the contact access to Invoice History.  A search level must be selected.

labels.webReferencePurchaseOrderDefault: Web Reference Purchase Order Default - If a PO is not entered, the system will use the web reference number as the PO.

labels.enablePrivateShipping: Enable Private Shipping -Enables users for private shipping.
labels.productGroups: Company Standard Product Groups - Although Product Groups are setup for the entire customer, this option disabled on a per-user basis.
labels.enableForceAttentionLineEntry: Enable Force Attention Line Entry - Forces the user to enter information into the attention line field.
labels.buyingHelp: Buying - Ability to place an order for purchase. This also needs to be turned on to create a requisition.
labels.viewTechBuysPage: - Allows the user to view the TechBuys page. TechBuys are created by Product Management. Products that are not in the users catalog will not appear on the TechBuys page.
labels.enableSCOLicensingServiceDesk: Enable SCO - Licensing Service Desk - Access to a variety of service types that provide validations, guidance, query response, license provisioning and ‎administration via a ServiceNOW engagement. Access dependency on established SCO engagement.
labels.allowShipComplete: Allow Ship Complete - Grants all linked contacts the ability to flag an order as "ship complete" on the ship/bill/pay page. Order Detail will display verbiage that the order has a "Ship Complete" status. The order is shipped to the Chicago warehouse until all items on the order are received. The order is placed on electronic hold. An email is sent to the rep advising them of the "Ship Complete" status.
labels.VPPDocuments: Allow Access to Customer Documents - Users that have the ability to view documents that have been uploaded to their VIP site will have this permission ON. The default of this checkbox for a new user is ON.
labels.displayListPrice: Display List Price - If enabled, list price displays (struck out), otherwise, only "Your Price" displays.
labels.enableOnlyMyQuoteTracking: Enable Only My Quote Tracking - Will grant access to all quotes created by the current session contact id for all soldto's in the current session web group. Partner program users have access to the current session soldto only.
labels.changeBillTO: Enable Change Billing Account - This gives the user the right to select from a drop down list of company approved bill to-s, and/or to create a free text bill to.
labels.userRequiresApproval: User Requires Approval - This is a feature to specify that a specific user profile does require approval.
labels.disablePriceAndStock: Disable Price and Stock - The feature will hide the display of stock and price in Company Standards, Product Detail, Search Results, Add to Cart popup, Transaction (Cart, Additional Order pages, Ship/Bill/Pay and order confirmations).
labels.forceCarrierAccountNumber: Force Carrier Account Number - Forces the customer to enter a carrier account number during checkout.
labels.userAccountSearch: User Account Search - Users that have the ability to view the User Accounts reporting section of the site will have this permission ON.
labels.viewCustomerOwnedInventory: View Customer Owned Inventory - Users can be given the ability to view their Customer Owned Inventory (a.k.a. Loc85).
labels.saveCart: Save Cart - This feature gives this user the ability to save, re-load, delete and/or export carts.
labels.reportingAllOrderSoldTosParent: -Return all orders for all soldto’s under the Reporting Parent
labels.openMarket: Open Market - Allows IPS user to view Open Market pricing.

labels.displyInsightWareHouseInventory: Display Insight Warehouse Inventory Only - Display Insight Warehouse Inventory Only.

labels.companyInfo: Company Info - This enables the About Insight link in the page footer.

labels.changeShipTo: Enable Change Shipping Account - This gives the user the right to select from a drop down list of company approved ship to-s.

labels.displayEWRFeesInCartDisplay: EWR Fees in Cart - EWR fees will calculate and display in the cart.
labels.enablePurchasingPopUp: Enable Purchasing Popup - The purchasing popup is a notification that shows each time a user adds an item to the cart.
labels.seletionAloowsToSeeItem: -This selection turned on, only allows the user to see the items that make up the custom catalog.
labels.limitsOrderLookUps: - Limits order lookups to just Order Number, Reference Number, Purchase Order Number or PO Release No for the specified level.  Can be combined with 'My Orders only' to return only 'My orders' by Number.
labels.vsppSplaAdminDesc: -  Grants access to manage reporting usage for VSPP and SPLA
labels.sortByBestSeller: Sort By Best Sellers- "Best Sellers" appears and is the default for Search Results.If disabled,the option does not appear in Search Results.
labels.viewOpenARAgingBuckets: - Allows users to view their open A/R aging buckets. This permission requires prior approval from the Credit department.
labels.freeSubscription: Free Subscriptions - Insight offers an email newsletter that provides product information; this on will allow the user to register for this feature.
labels.insightVPDesc: - Grants access to create and manage License View templates
labels.enableLineLevelEntry: Enable Line Level Entry - Custom checkout users have the ability to enter text at the line level during the checkout process.
labels.leasing: Leasing - Ability to view leasing information and prices.
labels.reportingHelpTextMain: -Allows a client to run various reports at different levels
labels.SDAServicePartConfigurator: - The SDA Service Part Configurator (located on the Configurators page) allows users to search for and add service parts to their order.
labels.accesToinvoiceUnderSession: - will grant access to all invoices created by the session contact id  for all soldto's in the specified level.  This includes rep created invoices which are linked to the session contact id.

labels.invoicesSoldToUnderRP: - Return all invoices for all soldto’s under the Reporting Parent
labels.htmlEmail: HTML E-Mail - If this is selected then the user will receive HTML emails. If not selected the emails will be sent in text.
labels.advancedShipmentNotifications: Advanced Shipment Notification - If this is selected the user will have the option to request an advanced shipment notification.
labels.contactUs: Contact Us - Allows the user to access the Contact Information page from the left menu.
labels.obcrAccessDesc: - Outbound Catalog Requestor access is granted via a nextDesk ticket
labels.approvalProcessSetUp: Approval Process Set-Up - If Super Approval Admin, the individual is the approval administrator for the approval system. This person will have access to the approval system to maintain users, unique checkout fields, approval groups, approvers and reporting functions.
labels.rebateFlags: - This allows the user to see the 'rebate' flag on SKUs where one applies. Customers that have special manufacturer pricing may not be able to take advantage of certain rebates.
labels.greaterAccessForShippingAddress: Greater Access For Shipping Address - Grants all linked contacts access to all active shipping addresses for all soldto linked to all "Available" web groups in the master group.
labels.limitApprovalProcessSetUp: Limit Approval Process Set-Up - If Limited Approval Admin, the individual is an approval administrator with only access to the Approval Management and Days to Approve/Deny Report .
labels.qualityForPart: - This feature allows the user to enter a quantity and/or price for a part number, and when the part achieves this criterion the user will receive an alert.
labels.userDefinedOptions: User Defined Options - This gives the user the ability to utilize the customized options in the checkout.
labels.careers: Careers - Allows the user to view job postings posted on the Careers link via the site map.
labels.eProcAdminDesc: - eProc Admin access is granted via a nextDesk ticket
labels.browseSearchFunstionlaity: - This allows the user to see the browse search functionality.

If enabled, the individual permission can be controlled per contact in the permissions tab under Product Look-up.
labels.licenseManger: Enable Enterprise License Manger - Provides customer access to their Enterprise License Manager site.
labels.enableGenericOrderHistory: Enable Generic Order History - Gives non-logged in users the ability to generic order status abilities. If enabled, shared users who do not have "Enable Order Tracking" or "Enable AR Invoicing" will have generic order status abilities.
labels.stagedProductSearchDesc: -Enables the view of Staged products in search results.  Staged products display as 'Call for Availability' and 'Contact Us for Pricing'
labels.siteMap: Site Map - View the Site Map page.
labels.enableAssociatedAccessories: - Enables the associated accessories for a product on full product overviews.
labels.accUnderGreatGrandParent: - Accounts under the Great Grand Parent
labels.allowEditOfShipingText: Allow Edit of Shipping Text - Grants the user the ability to edit the shipping Attention line and fax field.

labels.customerServices: Customer Service - This allows the user to select the Customer Service link on the site map.
labels.viewPricing: View Pricing - Enables showing price to user.

If disabled, the requestor can enter credit card information or leave the fields blank. If the fields are left blank, the final approver is required to enter the credit card information.
labels.returnAllOrdersUnderGrantParent: - Return all orders for all soldto’s under the Grant Parent
labels.reportingAllUnderGrandParent: -Return all orders for all soldto’s under the Grant Parent
labels.compareProductSpecification: - Allows users to compare 2-10 more product specifications side-by-side.
labels.grantContactAccessToOrderInformation: - Grants the contact access to Order History.  A search level must be selected.
